meaning: Red Sheet rows: HallJoy will not support these keyboards. Every red row is listed. A row is detected only from an exact USB identity (VID:PID plus the USB product string when the PID is shared or the product string is known); otherwise 'undetected' says why. The generated runtime catalog shows a red 'not supported' banner for detected rows when no analog source is connected.

models.evidence: AJAZZ_AK680V2_FIRMWARE_2026-10-17.md; Driveall configurator names the three PIDs 'AJAZZ AK680 V2' (80C1 is shared with an 'AJAZZ KEYBOARD' TFT config, 80C2 with supplier 1stplayer)
AJAZZ_AK820MAX_SONIX_80B1_2026-10-08.md; tester logs show product string 'AK820MAX' (PID 80B1 is shared with an 'AJAZZ KEYBOARD' TFT config)
IPI_FLASH75_AULA_AG75_CORSAIR_K70MAX_2026-10-12.md; Corsair firmware catalog: K70 MAX = 1B1C:1BC0, firmware 1.17.96 has no analog path

models.undetected: USB identity not established: the updater image keeps the runtime VID/PID compressed, and the devices in log 48 (2E3C:C365, 30FA:1440) are unidentified.
0C45:80D6 is shared with Type 84 Magnetic Pro (not red), the product string is unknown, and the red status applies to firmware 1.17 only.
Not a 'no support' keyboard: it runs the limited trial path and has its own notice (Mad68DualLimited, 28E9:3265).
